title: 球面支承安裝
summary: 從支承配置與熱位移出發，量化球面支承的轉角需求、滑動材料承壓、曲面摩擦力矩與偏心，再處理工廠預設偏移、墊層灌漿、運輸固定件拆除、型式試驗、現場位移指標與累積滑移磨耗，最後以萊茵河上兩座斜張橋的 120 MN 級球面支承更換與新建案例，說明頂升更換與交接紀錄。
summaryEn: Starting from bearing layout and thermal movement, quantify a spherical bearing's rotation demand, sliding-material pressure, curved-surface friction moment and eccentricity, then handle factory presetting, bedding grout, removal of transport fittings, type testing, movement indicators and accumulated sliding wear, closing with jacking replacement and handover records through 120 MN class spherical bearings on two Rhine cable-stayed bridges.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一聯鋼—混凝土複合連續梁，縱向固定點設在中間墩，最遠的活動支承距固定點 L = 180 m，α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C，設計梁溫 −5 至 45°C、參考溫度 20°C。最大伸縮 1.2×10⁻⁵×180,000×25 = 54 mm，即 ±54 mm，加 ±20 mm 餘裕後滑板行程 ±74 mm。安裝時梁溫 32°C，溫度預設 1.2×10⁻⁵×180,000×12 ≈ 26 mm（複合梁乾縮另計）。豎向反力 N = 12 MN、滑動材料容許壓力 45 MPa，A = 12/45 ≈ 0.267 m²，D = √(4A/π) ≈ 0.58 m。摩擦水平力 H = μN：常溫 0.03×12 = 0.36 MN，低溫啟動 0.05×12 = 0.6 MN，需由墩帽與錨栓承受。若把固定點移到聯的一端使 L = 360 m，行程變為 ±108 mm 加餘裕、預設約 52 mm，滑板與伸縮縫都要加大。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a steel–concrete composite continuous girder has its longitudinal fixed point at a central pier, the farthest sliding bearing is L = 180 m away, α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C, design girder temperatures run from −5 to 45°C with a 20°C reference. Maximum movement is 1.2×10⁻⁵×180,000×25 = 54 mm, i.e. ±54 mm, and with ±20 mm margin the plate travel is ±74 mm. Installed at a girder temperature of 32°C, the thermal preset is 1.2×10⁻⁵×180,000×12 ≈ 26 mm (composite-deck shrinkage added separately). For a vertical reaction N = 12 MN and an allowable sliding pressure of 45 MPa, A = 12/45 ≈ 0.267 m² and D = √(4A/π) ≈ 0.58 m. The friction force H = μN is 0.03×12 = 0.36 MN normally and 0.05×12 = 0.6 MN at cold breakaway, to be carried by the pier cap and anchors. Moving the fixed point to one end makes L = 360 m, so travel becomes ±108 mm plus margin and the preset about 52 mm, enlarging both plate and expansion joint. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「約束配置與熱位移」與「豎向反力與轉角需求」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Restraint layout and thermal movement" and "Vertical reaction and rotation demand": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 約束配置與熱位移：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Restraint layout and thermal movement: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」如何影響球面支承安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fixed, guided and free layout” governs force, deformation or durability in “Spherical bridge-bearing installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 一聯連續梁通常只設一個縱向固定點，其餘支承依需要做成單向導向（只允許縱向滑動）或雙向自由滑動，橫向約束則集中在少數導向支承上。溫度、混凝土潛變乾縮與預力縮短讓梁以固定點為原點伸縮，距固定點越遠的支承滑移量越大；球面支承把轉動交給球冠曲面、把滑動交給上方平面滑板，兩種自由度各自由不同滑動面負責。配置錯誤時，熱位移被束制，水平力直接打進橋墩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A continuous girder unit normally has a single longitudinal fixed point; the other bearings are guided (sliding only longitudinally) or free (sliding in all horizontal directions), and transverse restraint is concentrated in a few guided bearings. Temperature, concrete creep and shrinkage and prestress shortening make the deck expand and contract about the fixed point, so bearings farther from it slide more. A spherical bearing assigns rotation to its curved calotte and sliding to the flat plate above it, so each freedom has its own sliding surface. With a wrong layout, thermal movement is restrained and horizontal force is driven straight into the piers. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Fixed, guided and free layout” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：熱位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「固定支承越多，橋梁整體越穩固、越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more fixed bearings a bridge has, the more stable and safe it is." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Fixed, guided and free layout”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：固定支承越多，橋梁整體越穩固、越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The more fixed bearings a bridge has, the more stable and safe it is. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「約束配置與熱位移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Restraint layout and thermal movement" is correct?
options: 固定支承越多，橋梁整體越穩固、越安全。
一聯連續梁通常只設一個縱向固定點，其餘支承依需要做成單向導向（只允許縱向滑動）或雙向自由滑動，橫向約束則集中在少數導向支承上。
球面支承能轉動任何角度，所以轉角不需要計算。
optionsEn: The more fixed bearings a bridge has, the more stable and safe it is.
A continuous girder unit normally has a single longitudinal fixed point.
A spherical bearing can rotate through any angle, so rotation need not be calculated.
quiz.explanation: 一聯連續梁通常只設一個縱向固定點，其餘支承依需要做成單向導向（只允許縱向滑動）或雙向自由滑動，橫向約束則集中在少數導向支承上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A continuous girder unit normally has a single longitudinal fixed point; the other bearings are guided (sliding only longitudinally) or free (sliding in all horizontal directions), and transverse restraint is concentrated in a few guided bearings. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 約束配置與熱位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Restraint layout and thermal movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fixed, guided and free layout” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：熱位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。鋼—混凝土複合梁 α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C、支承距固定點 L = 240 m、有效溫差 ΔT = 60°C，ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×240,000 mm×60 = 172.8 mm，約為平均位置 ±86 mm；若把固定點從聯中央移到端部，L 變為 480 m，滑移量加倍到約 346 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. For a steel–concrete composite girder with α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C, a bearing L = 240 m from the fixed point and an effective range ΔT = 60°C, ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×240,000 mm×60 = 172.8 mm, about ±86 mm from the mean position; moving the fixed point from mid-unit to the end makes L = 480 m and doubles the travel to about 346 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把支承一覽表（編號、型式 KF/KE/KA、導向方向、設計位移與轉角）與平面配置圖逐一比對，確認每一聯只有一個縱向固定點、導向方向與位移方向一致；再以結構模型輸出各支承的位移包絡，核對滑板長度是否涵蓋位移加安全餘裕。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the bearing schedule (number, type KF/KE/KA, guide direction, design movement and rotation) item by item with the layout plan, confirming one longitudinal fixed point per unit and guide directions aligned with movement; then check the movement envelope from the structural model against each sliding plate length plus margin.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「約束配置與熱位移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Restraint layout and thermal movement", which statement holds?
options: 球面支承完全不傳遞彎矩，可以當成理想鉸接點。
調整高程用的鋼墊片可以留著當作永久的傳力路徑。
熱位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
optionsEn: A spherical bearing transmits no moment at all and can be treated as an ideal pin.
Steel shims used for levelling can stay as the permanent load path.
Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
quiz.explanation: 熱位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 約束配置與熱位移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Restraint layout and thermal movement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fixed, guided and free layout” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把支承一覽表（編號、型式 KF/KE/KA、導向方向、設計位移與轉角）與平面配置圖逐一比對，確認每一聯只有一個縱向固定點、導向方向與位移方向一致；再以結構模型輸出各支承的位移包絡，核對滑板長度是否涵蓋位移加安全餘裕。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the bearing schedule (number, type KF/KE/KA, guide direction, design movement and rotation) item by item with the layout plan, confirming one longitudinal fixed point per unit and guide directions aligned with movement; then check the movement envelope from the structural model against each sliding plate length plus margin. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：支承一覽表要附箭頭示意圖標出每個支承的可動方向與固定點，曲線橋與斜橋的導向方向須以指向固定點的弦線決定，並由設計者在施工圖上簽認後才進行製造。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The bearing schedule must include an arrow diagram showing each bearing's free directions and the fixed point; for curved and skewed bridges the guide direction follows the chord toward the fixed point, and the designer signs it off on the construction drawings before fabrication.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一聯出現兩個縱向固定支承，或導向方向與曲線橋的實際位移方向不一致，夏季膨脹被束制後在墩頂產生數百 kN 至數 MN 的約束力，常見徵兆是墩身水平裂縫、導向條磨損發亮與伸縮縫開口異常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two longitudinal fixed bearings in one unit, or guide directions that do not follow the real movement of a curved deck, restrain summer expansion and generate restraint forces of hundreds of kN to several MN at the pier tops; typical signs are horizontal pier cracks, polished guide strips and abnormal expansion-joint gaps. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 支承一覽表要附箭頭示意圖標出每個支承的可動方向與固定點，曲線橋與斜橋的導向方向須以指向固定點的弦線決定，並由設計者在施工圖上簽認後才進行製造。

quiz.question: 要驗證「約束配置與熱位移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Restraint layout and thermal movement"?
options: 把支承一覽表（編號、型式 KF/KE/KA、導向方向、設計位移與轉角）與平面配置圖逐一比對，確認每一聯只有一個縱向固定點、導向方向與位移方向一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
位移指針還在刻度範圍內，就代表支承功能正常。
optionsEn: Compare the bearing schedule (number, type KF/KE/KA, guide direction, design movement and rotation) item by item with the layout plan, confirming one longitudinal fixed point per unit and guide directions aligned with movement.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the movement pointer is still within the scale, the bearing is working properly.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare the bearing schedule (number, type KF/KE/KA, guide direction, design movement and rotation) item by item with the layout plan, confirming one longitudinal fixed point per unit and guide directions aligned with movement; then check the movement envelope from the structural model against each sliding plate length plus margin. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 約束配置與熱位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Restraint layout and thermal movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「固定、單向、雙向支承配置」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fixed, guided and free layout” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一聯出現兩個縱向固定支承，或導向方向與曲線橋的實際位移方向不一致，夏季膨脹被束制後在墩頂產生數百 kN 至數 MN 的約束力，常見徵兆是墩身水平裂縫、導向條磨損發亮與伸縮縫開口異常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two longitudinal fixed bearings in one unit, or guide directions that do not follow the real movement of a curved deck, restrain summer expansion and generate restraint forces of hundreds of kN to several MN at the pier tops; typical signs are horizontal pier cracks, polished guide strips and abnormal expansion-joint gaps. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：配置錯誤時，熱位移被束制，水平力直接打進橋墩。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With a wrong layout, thermal movement is restrained and horizontal force is driven straight into the piers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「固定支承越多，橋梁整體越穩固、越安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The more fixed bearings a bridge has, the more stable and safe it is." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一聯出現兩個縱向固定支承，或導向方向與曲線橋的實際位移方向不一致，夏季膨脹被束制後在墩頂產生數百 kN 至數 MN 的約束力，常見徵兆是墩身水平裂縫、導向條磨損發亮與伸縮縫開口異常。
knowledge.textEn: Two longitudinal fixed bearings in one unit, or guide directions that do not follow the real movement of a curved deck, restrain summer expansion and generate restraint forces of hundreds of kN to several MN at the pier tops; typical signs are horizontal pier cracks, polished guide strips and abnormal expansion-joint gaps.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「約束配置與熱位移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Restraint layout and thermal movement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
同一聯出現兩個縱向固定支承，或導向方向與曲線橋的實際位移方向不一致，夏季膨脹被束制後在墩頂產生數百 kN 至數 MN 的約束力，常見徵兆是墩身水平裂縫、導向條磨損發亮與伸縮縫開口異常。
球面支承能轉動任何角度，所以轉角不需要計算。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Two longitudinal fixed bearings in one unit, or guide directions that do not follow the real movement of a curved deck, restrain summer expansion and generate restraint forces of hundreds of kN to several MN at the pier tops.
A spherical bearing can rotate through any angle, so rotation need not be calculated.
quiz.explanation: 同一聯出現兩個縱向固定支承，或導向方向與曲線橋的實際位移方向不一致，夏季膨脹被束制後在墩頂產生數百 kN 至數 MN 的約束力，常見徵兆是墩身水平裂縫、導向條磨損發亮與伸縮縫開口異常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Two longitudinal fixed bearings in one unit, or guide directions that do not follow the real movement of a curved deck, restrain summer expansion and generate restraint forces of hundreds of kN to several MN at the pier tops; typical signs are horizontal pier cracks, polished guide strips and abnormal expansion-joint gaps. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 豎向反力與轉角需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Vertical reaction and rotation demand: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「設計轉角 θ」如何影響球面支承安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Design rotation θ” governs force, deformation or durability in “Spherical bridge-bearing installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 梁端在活載、溫度梯度、預拱與施工誤差作用下會繞橫軸轉動，曲線橋與寬橋還有繞縱軸的轉動；球面支承讓上方的凸面球冠在下方凹面座內滑動，因此可以同時容納任意方向的轉角，而且轉動時接觸面壓力分布幾乎不變，這是它相對於盆式或橡膠支承的主要優勢。設計轉角必須把結構計算值加上製造與安裝允差，因為支承座板很難做到完全水平。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「設計轉角 θ」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Under live load, thermal gradient, camber and construction tolerances the girder end rotates about the transverse axis, and curved or wide decks also rotate about the longitudinal axis. In a spherical bearing the convex calotte slides inside a concave seat, so it accommodates rotation in any direction while the contact pressure distribution stays almost unchanged, its main advantage over pot or elastomeric bearings. The design rotation must add fabrication and installation tolerances to the structural value, because bearing plates are never set perfectly level. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Design rotation θ” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡支梁受均布荷重端轉角 θ = wL³/(24EI)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a simply supported span under uniform load the end rotation is θ = wL³/(24EI).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「球面支承能轉動任何角度，所以轉角不需要計算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A spherical bearing can rotate through any angle, so rotation need not be calculated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「設計轉角 θ」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Design rotation θ”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 豎向反力與轉角需求
knowledge.text: 梁端在活載、溫度梯度、預拱與施工誤差作用下會繞橫軸轉動，曲線橋與寬橋還有繞縱軸的轉動；球面支承讓上方的凸面球冠在下方凹面座內滑動，因此可以同時容納任意方向的轉角，而且轉動時接觸面壓力分布幾乎不變，這是它相對於盆式或橡膠支承的主要優勢。設計轉角必須把結構計算值加上製造與安裝允差，因為支承座板很難做到完全水平。
knowledge.textEn: Under live load, thermal gradient, camber and construction tolerances the girder end rotates about the transverse axis, and curved or wide decks also rotate about the longitudinal axis. In a spherical bearing the convex calotte slides inside a concave seat, so it accommodates rotation in any direction while the contact pressure distribution stays almost unchanged, its main advantage over pot or elastomeric bearings.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：球面支承能轉動任何角度，所以轉角不需要計算。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A spherical bearing can rotate through any angle, so rotation need not be calculated. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「豎向反力與轉角需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vertical reaction and rotation demand" is correct?
options: 球面支承能轉動任何角度，所以轉角不需要計算。
PTFE 不會磨損，所以滑動支承裝好之後就是免維護的。
梁端在活載、溫度梯度、預拱與施工誤差作用下會繞橫軸轉動，曲線橋與寬橋還有繞縱軸的轉動。
optionsEn: A spherical bearing can rotate through any angle, so rotation need not be calculated.
PTFE does not wear, so a sliding bearing is maintenance-free once installed.
Under live load, thermal gradient, camber and construction tolerances the girder end rotates about the transverse axis, and curved or wide decks also rotate about the longitudinal axis.
quiz.explanation: 梁端在活載、溫度梯度、預拱與施工誤差作用下會繞橫軸轉動，曲線橋與寬橋還有繞縱軸的轉動；球面支承讓上方的凸面球冠在下方凹面座內滑動，因此可以同時容納任意方向的轉角，而且轉動時接觸面壓力分布幾乎不變，這是它相對於盆式或橡膠支承的主要優勢。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Under live load, thermal gradient, camber and construction tolerances the girder end rotates about the transverse axis, and curved or wide decks also rotate about the longitudinal axis. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 豎向反力與轉角需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vertical reaction and rotation demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設計轉角 θ」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Design rotation θ” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡支梁受均布荷重端轉角 θ = wL³/(24EI)。取 w = 120 kN/m、L = 60 m、E = 34 GPa、I = 12 m⁴，EI = 4.08×10¹¹ N·m²，θ = 120,000×60³/(24×4.08×10¹¹) = 2.592×10¹⁰/9.79×10¹² ≈ 0.0026 rad；加計 0.005 rad 安裝允差後約 0.0076 rad，規格取 0.01 rad。數值為教學假設，允差依適用規範核定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a simply supported span under uniform load the end rotation is θ = wL³/(24EI). With w = 120 kN/m, L = 60 m, E = 34 GPa and I = 12 m⁴, EI = 4.08×10¹¹ N·m² and θ = 120,000×60³/(24×4.08×10¹¹) = 2.592×10¹⁰/9.79×10¹² ≈ 0.0026 rad; adding a 0.005 rad installation allowance gives about 0.0076 rad, specified as 0.01 rad. Values are teaching assumptions; tolerances follow the governing code. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以結構模型輸出各荷載組合下支承處兩個方向的轉角包絡，加上規範要求的允差後與製造商的額定轉角比較；施工時以精密水準儀量測上下座板的坡度，確認安裝後的初始傾斜沒有吃掉設計轉角餘裕。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Extract the rotation envelope about both axes at each bearing for all load combinations, add the code tolerance and compare with the manufacturer's rated rotation; during construction measure the slope of the upper and lower plates with a precise level to confirm the as-installed tilt has not consumed the rotation margin.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 簡支梁受均布荷重端轉角 θ = wL³/(24EI)。取 w = 120 kN/m、L = 60 m、E = 34 GPa、I = 12 m⁴，EI = 4.08×10¹¹ N·m²，θ = 120,000×60³/(24×4.08×10¹¹) = 2.592×10¹⁰/9.79×10¹² ≈ 0.0026 rad；加計 0.005 rad 安裝允差後約 0.0076 rad，規格取 0.01 rad。數值為教學假設，允差依適用規範核定。
knowledge.textEn: For a simply supported span under uniform load the end rotation is θ = wL³/(24EI). With w = 120 kN/m, L = 60 m, E = 34 GPa and I = 12 m⁴, EI = 4.08×10¹¹ N·m² and θ = 120,000×60³/(24×4.08×10¹¹) = 2.592×10¹⁰/9.79×10¹² ≈ 0.0026 rad; adding a 0.005 rad installation allowance gives about 0.0076 rad, specified as 0.01 rad. Values are teaching assumptions; tolerances follow the governing code.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「豎向反力與轉角需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vertical reaction and rotation demand", which statement holds?
options: 簡支梁受均布荷重端轉角 θ = wL³/(24EI)。
安裝當天的氣溫就等於梁體溫度，可以直接拿來設定預設量。
支承只要額定荷重夠大，任何轉角與溫度下都一定合格。
optionsEn: For a simply supported span under uniform load the end rotation is θ = wL³/(24EI).
The air temperature on installation day equals the girder temperature and can be used directly to set the preset.
If a bearing's rated load is high enough, it passes at any rotation and temperature.
quiz.explanation: 簡支梁受均布荷重端轉角 θ = wL³/(24EI)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a simply supported span under uniform load the end rotation is θ = wL³/(24EI). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 豎向反力與轉角需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vertical reaction and rotation demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「設計轉角 θ」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Design rotation θ” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以結構模型輸出各荷載組合下支承處兩個方向的轉角包絡，加上規範要求的允差後與製造商的額定轉角比較；施工時以精密水準儀量測上下座板的坡度，確認安裝後的初始傾斜沒有吃掉設計轉角餘裕。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Extract the rotation envelope about both axes at each bearing for all load combinations, add the code tolerance and compare with the manufacturer's rated rotation; during construction measure the slope of the upper and lower plates with a precise level to confirm the as-installed tilt has not consumed the rotation margin. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：支承規格書要分列結構轉角、允差與總設計轉角，並註明繞哪兩個軸；製造商圖面須標示金屬接觸前的最大轉角與剩餘間隙，作為現場檢查的比對值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The bearing specification lists structural rotation, tolerance and total design rotation separately and names both axes; the manufacturer's drawing must show the maximum rotation before metal contact and the remaining clearance as a reference for site inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若轉角需求低估，球冠滑到凹面邊緣後上座板與下座板金屬接觸（硬點），反力集中在邊緣，可能壓壞滑動材料、使座板翹曲並在梁底或墩帽造成局部壓碎。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If rotation demand is underestimated, the calotte runs to the edge of the concave seat and the upper and lower plates touch metal to metal, concentrating the reaction at the edge, which can crush the sliding material, warp the plates and locally crush the girder soffit or pier cap. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以結構模型輸出各荷載組合下支承處兩個方向的轉角包絡，加上規範要求的允差後與製造商的額定轉角比較；施工時以精密水準儀量測上下座板的坡度，確認安裝後的初始傾斜沒有吃掉設計轉角餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Extract the rotation envelope about both axes at each bearing for all load combinations, add the code tolerance and compare with the manufacturer's rated rotation; during construction measure the slope of the upper and lower plates with a precise level to confirm the as-installed tilt has not consumed the rotation margin.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 支承規格書要分列結構轉角、允差與總設計轉角，並註明繞哪兩個軸；製造商圖面須標示金屬接觸前的最大轉角與剩餘間隙，作為現場檢查的比對值。
knowledge.textEn: The bearing specification lists structural rotation, tolerance and total design rotation separately and names both axes; the manufacturer's drawing must show the maximum rotation before metal contact and the remaining clearance as a reference for site inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「豎向反力與轉角需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Vertical reaction and rotation demand"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以結構模型輸出各荷載組合下支承處兩個方向的轉角包絡，加上規範要求的允差後與製造商的額定轉角比較。
支承的磨耗只取決於季節溫差造成的大位移。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Extract the rotation envelope about both axes at each bearing for all load combinations, add the code tolerance and compare with the manufacturer's rated rotation.
Bearing wear depends only on the large seasonal thermal movements.
quiz.explanation: 以結構模型輸出各荷載組合下支承處兩個方向的轉角包絡，加上規範要求的允差後與製造商的額定轉角比較；施工時以精密水準儀量測上下座板的坡度，確認安裝後的初始傾斜沒有吃掉設計轉角餘裕。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Extract the rotation envelope about both axes at each bearing for all load combinations, add the code tolerance and compare with the manufacturer's rated rotation; during construction measure the slope of the upper and lower plates with a precise level to confirm the as-installed tilt has not consumed the rotation margin. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 豎向反力與轉角需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vertical reaction and rotation demand: failure diagnosis

steps.title: 球冠、滑板與滑動材料：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Calotte, sliding plates and sliding materials: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「球冠與滑動材料承壓」如何影響球面支承安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Calotte and sliding-material pressure” governs force, deformation or durability in “Spherical bridge-bearing installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 球面支承由下座板（凹面）、球冠（凸面，常為鍍硬鉻或包覆不鏽鋼）與上滑板組成，兩個滑動面各嵌一層滑動材料：傳統為 PTFE，近年也有改質超高分子量聚乙烯與專利滑動材料，與拋光不鏽鋼板配對並以矽脂潤滑。滑動材料嵌在凹槽中受側向圍束，承壓能力因此遠高於自由狀態；它的容許壓力決定了球冠直徑與整個支承的平面尺寸，進而決定墩帽上需要的支承面積與邊距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「球冠與滑動材料承壓」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A spherical bearing has a lower plate with a concave surface, a convex calotte (usually hard-chromed or clad in stainless steel) and an upper sliding plate; each of the two sliding surfaces carries a sliding-material layer, traditionally PTFE and more recently modified ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene or proprietary materials, mated with polished stainless steel and lubricated with silicone grease. Recessed in a groove, the material is laterally confined and carries far more pressure than when free; its allowable pressure fixes the calotte diameter and the plan size of the bearing, and hence the bearing area and edge distances needed on the pier cap. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Calotte and sliding-material pressure” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：所需滑動面積 A = N/σ_allow。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Required sliding area A = N/σ_allow.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「PTFE 不會磨損，所以滑動支承裝好之後就是免維護的。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "PTFE does not wear, so a sliding bearing is maintenance-free once installed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「球冠與滑動材料承壓」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Calotte and sliding-material pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 球冠、滑板與滑動材料：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Calotte, sliding plates and sliding materials: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「球冠與滑動材料承壓」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Calotte and sliding-material pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：所需滑動面積 A = N/σ_allow。N = 20 MN、σ_allow = 45 MPa 時 A = 20/45 ≈ 0.444 m²，圓盤直徑 D = √(4A/π) ≈ 0.75 m；若改用承壓約為兩倍的滑動材料（σ_allow = 90 MPa），A ≈ 0.222 m²，D ≈ 0.53 m。數值為教學假設，非任何產品的設計值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Required sliding area A = N/σ_allow. With N = 20 MN and σ_allow = 45 MPa, A = 20/45 ≈ 0.444 m² and the disc diameter is D = √(4A/π) ≈ 0.75 m; a sliding material with about twice the pressure capacity (σ_allow = 90 MPa) gives A ≈ 0.222 m² and D ≈ 0.53 m. Values are teaching assumptions, not product design values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：審查滑動材料的型式試驗或歐洲技術評估文件（ETA）、不鏽鋼板表面粗糙度與硬度、球冠鍍層厚度與材料證明；出廠前量測凹凸面曲率半徑與配合間隙，確認滑動材料嵌入深度、外露高度與潤滑凹坑符合圖面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review the sliding material's type tests or European Technical Assessment, the stainless sheet roughness and hardness, the calotte coating thickness and mill certificates; before delivery measure the curvature radii and fit of the concave and convex surfaces and confirm the material's recess depth, protrusion and lubrication dimples against the drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 球冠、滑板與滑動材料：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Calotte, sliding plates and sliding materials: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「球冠與滑動材料承壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Calotte and sliding-material pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 審查滑動材料的型式試驗或歐洲技術評估文件（ETA）、不鏽鋼板表面粗糙度與硬度、球冠鍍層厚度與材料證明；出廠前量測凹凸面曲率半徑與配合間隙，確認滑動材料嵌入深度、外露高度與潤滑凹坑符合圖面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review the sliding material's type tests or European Technical Assessment, the stainless sheet roughness and hardness, the calotte coating thickness and mill certificates; before delivery measure the curvature radii and fit of the concave and convex surfaces and confirm the material's recess depth, protrusion and lubrication dimples against the drawings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採購規範要求滑動材料具型式試驗與累積滑移能力的證明，不鏽鋼面不得塗裝或焊濺，運送與安裝期間以護蓋保護滑動面；任何現場打磨或焊接都必須遠離滑動面並經監造同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The procurement specification requires type-test evidence and a stated accumulated-sliding capacity for the sliding material; stainless surfaces must not be painted or weld-spattered and stay covered during transport and installation, and any site grinding or welding must keep clear of sliding surfaces with the inspector's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：滑動材料長期在高壓與頻繁往復滑動下會冷流外擠：萊茵河諾伊維德的萊夫艾森橋原有盆式支承，其滑板中的 PTFE 就因頻繁移動被側向擠出而必須更換，外擠後摩擦升高、金屬面互磨。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Under high pressure and frequent reciprocating movement a sliding material can cold-flow out of its recess: the original pot bearings of the Raiffeisen Bridge at Neuwied on the Rhine had to be replaced because the PTFE in their sliding plates was pressed out laterally by frequent movement, raising friction and letting metal surfaces rub. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 審查滑動材料的型式試驗或歐洲技術評估文件（ETA）、不鏽鋼板表面粗糙度與硬度、球冠鍍層厚度與材料證明；出廠前量測凹凸面曲率半徑與配合間隙，確認滑動材料嵌入深度、外露高度與潤滑凹坑符合圖面。
knowledge.textEn: Review the sliding material's type tests or European Technical Assessment, the stainless sheet roughness and hardness, the calotte coating thickness and mill certificates; before delivery measure the curvature radii and fit of the concave and convex surfaces and confirm the material's recess depth, protrusion and lubrication dimples against the drawings.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 採購規範要求滑動材料具型式試驗與累積滑移能力的證明，不鏽鋼面不得塗裝或焊濺，運送與安裝期間以護蓋保護滑動面；任何現場打磨或焊接都必須遠離滑動面並經監造同意。
knowledge.textEn: The procurement specification requires type-test evidence and a stated accumulated-sliding capacity for the sliding material; stainless surfaces must not be painted or weld-spattered and stay covered during transport and installation, and any site grinding or welding must keep clear of sliding surfaces with the inspector's approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「球冠、滑板與滑動材料」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 球冠、滑板與滑動材料：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Calotte, sliding plates and sliding materials: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「球冠與滑動材料承壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Calotte and sliding-material pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 滑動材料長期在高壓與頻繁往復滑動下會冷流外擠：萊茵河諾伊維德的萊夫艾森橋原有盆式支承，其滑板中的 PTFE 就因頻繁移動被側向擠出而必須更換，外擠後摩擦升高、金屬面互磨。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Under high pressure and frequent reciprocating movement a sliding material can cold-flow out of its recess: the original pot bearings of the Raiffeisen Bridge at Neuwied on the Rhine had to be replaced because the PTFE in their sliding plates was pressed out laterally by frequent movement, raising friction and letting metal surfaces rub. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：滑動材料嵌在凹槽中受側向圍束，承壓能力因此遠高於自由狀態；它的容許壓力決定了球冠直徑與整個支承的平面尺寸，進而決定墩帽上需要的支承面積與邊距。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Recessed in a groove, the material is laterally confined and carries far more pressure than when free; its allowable pressure fixes the calotte diameter and the plan size of the bearing, and hence the bearing area and edge distances needed on the pier cap.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「PTFE 不會磨損，所以滑動支承裝好之後就是免維護的。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "PTFE does not wear, so a sliding bearing is maintenance-free once installed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 摩擦力矩、偏心與水平力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Friction moment, eccentricity and horizontal force: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「曲面摩擦力矩 M = μNR」如何影響球面支承安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curved-surface friction moment” governs force, deformation or durability in “Spherical bridge-bearing installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 球面支承轉動時，球冠必須在曲面上滑動，摩擦力 μN 作用在曲率半徑 R 上，形成抵抗轉動的力矩，等同把豎向反力的作用線偏移一段距離 e；上滑板在平面上滑動時，摩擦力 μN 則以水平力傳入墩帽與錨栓。摩擦係數隨壓力升高而降低、隨低溫與首次啟動而升高，因此設計要同時檢查常溫與低溫情境。這些力矩與水平力雖小於主反力，卻足以控制墩帽邊緣、梁底加勁與錨栓設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「曲面摩擦力矩 M = μNR」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When a spherical bearing rotates the calotte must slide on its curved surface, so the friction force μN acting at radius R creates a moment that resists rotation, equivalent to shifting the line of action of the vertical reaction by an eccentricity e. When the upper plate slides on the flat surface, μN enters the pier cap and anchors as a horizontal force. Friction falls as pressure rises and rises at low temperature and at first breakaway, so design checks both normal and cold conditions. These moments and forces are small compared with the main reaction but can govern pier-cap edges, girder stiffeners and anchors. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Curved-surface friction moment” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：曲面摩擦力矩 M = μ·N·R，等效偏心 e = M/N = μ·R，平面滑動水平力 H = μ·N。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: M = μ·N·R, e = M/N = μ·R and H = μ·N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「球面支承完全不傳遞彎矩，可以當成理想鉸接點。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A spherical bearing transmits no moment at all and can be treated as an ideal pin." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「曲面摩擦力矩 M = μNR」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Curved-surface friction moment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 摩擦力矩、偏心與水平力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Friction moment, eccentricity and horizontal force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲面摩擦力矩 M = μNR」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Curved-surface friction moment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：曲面摩擦力矩 M = μ·N·R，等效偏心 e = M/N = μ·R，平面滑動水平力 H = μ·N。取 N = 20 MN、μ = 0.03、R = 1.2 m：M = 0.03×20×1.2 = 0.72 MN·m，e = 0.036 m = 36 mm，H = 0.6 MN；低溫啟動 μ = 0.05 時 H 升為 1.0 MN、e 為 60 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: M = μ·N·R, e = M/N = μ·R and H = μ·N. With N = 20 MN, μ = 0.03 and R = 1.2 m: M = 0.03×20×1.2 = 0.72 MN·m, e = 0.036 m = 36 mm and H = 0.6 MN; at a cold breakaway μ = 0.05, H rises to 1.0 MN and e to 60 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在墩帽與梁底局部分析中把反力置於偏心 e 處並施加 H，檢查支承下混凝土局部承壓、邊距與錨栓剪力；核對支承製造商提供的設計摩擦係數與其型式試驗溫度範圍是否涵蓋橋址最低溫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In local analyses of the pier cap and girder soffit place the reaction at eccentricity e and apply H, checking concrete bearing pressure, edge distances and anchor shear; confirm the manufacturer's design friction coefficient and the temperature range of its type tests cover the site's minimum temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 摩擦力矩、偏心與水平力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Friction moment, eccentricity and horizontal force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曲面摩擦力矩 M = μNR」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Curved-surface friction moment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在墩帽與梁底局部分析中把反力置於偏心 e 處並施加 H，檢查支承下混凝土局部承壓、邊距與錨栓剪力；核對支承製造商提供的設計摩擦係數與其型式試驗溫度範圍是否涵蓋橋址最低溫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In local analyses of the pier cap and girder soffit place the reaction at eccentricity e and apply H, checking concrete bearing pressure, edge distances and anchor shear; confirm the manufacturer's design friction coefficient and the temperature range of its type tests cover the site's minimum temperature. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：圖面要標示設計摩擦係數、偏心 e 與水平力 H，並由結構設計者確認墩帽與梁底已按此設計；短墩或高墩頂的多支承情況，要明確寫出摩擦力的累加或分配假設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings state the design friction coefficient, eccentricity e and horizontal force H, and the structural designer confirms the pier cap and girder soffit are designed for them; for short piers or multiple bearings on one pier top, state explicitly how friction forces are summed or distributed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把球面支承視為零力矩、零水平力的理想鉸，墩帽邊緣可能出現劈裂裂縫，梁底加勁板在偏心反力下局部屈曲；多支承同時低溫啟動時，累加的摩擦水平力可能超過短墩的設計剪力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating a spherical bearing as an ideal hinge with no moment and no horizontal force can lead to splitting cracks at pier-cap edges and local buckling of girder bearing stiffeners under the eccentric reaction; when several bearings break away together in cold weather, the summed friction can exceed the design shear of a short pier. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 在墩帽與梁底局部分析中把反力置於偏心 e 處並施加 H，檢查支承下混凝土局部承壓、邊距與錨栓剪力；核對支承製造商提供的設計摩擦係數與其型式試驗溫度範圍是否涵蓋橋址最低溫。

quiz.question: 要驗證「摩擦力矩、偏心與水平力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 摩擦力矩、偏心與水平力：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曲面摩擦力矩 M = μNR」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Curved-surface friction moment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把球面支承視為零力矩、零水平力的理想鉸，墩帽邊緣可能出現劈裂裂縫，梁底加勁板在偏心反力下局部屈曲；多支承同時低溫啟動時，累加的摩擦水平力可能超過短墩的設計剪力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating a spherical bearing as an ideal hinge with no moment and no horizontal force can lead to splitting cracks at pier-cap edges and local buckling of girder bearing stiffeners under the eccentric reaction; when several bearings break away together in cold weather, the summed friction can exceed the design shear of a short pier. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預設偏移與溫度修正」與「墊層灌漿、錨栓與荷重轉移」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Presetting and temperature correction" and "Bedding grout, anchors and load transfer": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預設偏移與溫度修正：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Presetting and temperature correction: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「預設偏移量」如何影響球面支承安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Preset offset” governs force, deformation or durability in “Spherical bridge-bearing installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 支承在工廠組裝時，上滑板相對下部會預先偏移一段距離，使橋梁在長期平均狀態下滑板回到中央，左右兩側都保留相同的滑移量。偏移量取決於安裝當時的梁體有效溫度與設計參考溫度之差，以及安裝後才發生的潛變、乾縮與預力縮短；因此預設值在製造前就要指定，並附一張依安裝溫度修正的表。製造商通常規定預設只能在工廠完成，現場調整須由受訓人員依程序執行。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「預設偏移量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At factory assembly the upper sliding plate is offset from the lower part so that, in the long-term average state, the plate returns to centre with equal travel left on both sides. The offset depends on the difference between the girder's effective temperature at installation and the design reference temperature, plus the creep, shrinkage and prestress shortening that occur after installation; it must therefore be specified before fabrication together with a correction table by installation temperature. Manufacturers normally require presetting in the factory, with any site adjustment done only by trained personnel following a procedure. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Preset offset” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：預設 Δp = α·L·(T_install − T_ref) + ε_cs·L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Preset Δp = α·L·(T_install − T_ref) + ε_cs·L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「安裝當天的氣溫就等於梁體溫度，可以直接拿來設定預設量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The air temperature on installation day equals the girder temperature and can be used directly to set the preset." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「預設偏移量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Preset offset”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The air temperature on installation day equals the girder temperature and can be used directly to set the preset. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預設偏移與溫度修正」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Presetting and temperature correction" is correct?
options: 安裝當天的氣溫就等於梁體溫度，可以直接拿來設定預設量。
調整高程用的鋼墊片可以留著當作永久的傳力路徑。
支承在工廠組裝時，上滑板相對下部會預先偏移一段距離，使橋梁在長期平均狀態下滑板回到中央，左右兩側都保留相同的滑移量。

quiz.explanationEn: At factory assembly the upper sliding plate is offset from the lower part so that, in the long-term average state, the plate returns to centre with equal travel left on both sides. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預設偏移與溫度修正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Presetting and temperature correction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預設偏移量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Preset offset” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預設 Δp = α·L·(T_install − T_ref) + ε_cs·L。混凝土梁 α = 1.0×10⁻⁵ /°C、L = 180 m、安裝時梁溫 30°C、參考 15°C：溫度部分 1.0×10⁻⁵×180,000×15 = 27 mm；潛變乾縮 ε_cs = 3.0×10⁻⁴，得 54 mm；合計 81 mm，偏向遠離固定點。若在 10°C 安裝，溫度部分變為 −9 mm，總預設 45 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Preset Δp = α·L·(T_install − T_ref) + ε_cs·L. For a concrete girder with α = 1.0×10⁻⁵ /°C, L = 180 m, 30°C girder temperature at installation and a 15°C reference: thermal part 1.0×10⁻⁵×180,000×15 = 27 mm; creep and shrinkage ε_cs = 3.0×10⁻⁴ give 54 mm; total 81 mm, set away from the fixed point. Installing at 10°C makes the thermal part −9 mm and the total preset 45 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以埋設或貼附在梁體的溫度計取得有效梁溫（不是氣溫），在固定錨栓前依修正表確認預設刻度，拍照記錄刻度與溫度讀值；若安裝溫度超出表列範圍，暫停並請設計者與製造商重算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain the effective girder temperature from embedded or surface-mounted thermometers, not air temperature, confirm the preset scale against the correction table before anchors are fixed, and photograph the scale with the temperature reading; if the installation temperature is outside the table, stop and ask the designer and manufacturer to recalculate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 預設 Δp = α·L·(T_install − T_ref) + ε_cs·L。混凝土梁 α = 1.0×10⁻⁵ /°C、L = 180 m、安裝時梁溫 30°C、參考 15°C：溫度部分 1.0×10⁻⁵×180,000×15 = 27 mm；潛變乾縮 ε_cs = 3.0×10⁻⁴，得 54 mm；合計 81 mm，偏向遠離固定點。若在 10°C 安裝，溫度部分變為 −9 mm，總預設 45 mm。數值為教學假設。

For a concrete girder with α = 1.0×10⁻⁵ /°C, L = 180 m, 30°C girder temperature at installation and a 15°C reference: thermal part 1.0×10⁻⁵×180,000×15 = 27 mm; creep and shrinkage ε_cs = 3.0×10⁻⁴ give 54 mm; total 81 mm, set away from the fixed point. Installing at 10°C makes the thermal part −9 mm and the total preset 45 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預設偏移與溫度修正」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Presetting and temperature correction", which statement holds?
options: 預設 Δp = α·L·(T_install − T_ref) + ε_cs·L。
位移指針還在刻度範圍內，就代表支承功能正常。
支承更換只要把舊的拆掉、換上同型號的新品即可，不需要設計者介入。

If the movement pointer is still within the scale, the bearing is working properly.
Replacing a bearing just means removing the old one and fitting the same model; no designer involvement is needed.
quiz.explanation: 預設 Δp = α·L·(T_install − T_ref) + ε_cs·L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Preset Δp = α·L·(T_install − T_ref) + ε_cs·L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預設偏移與溫度修正：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Presetting and temperature correction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預設偏移量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Preset offset” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以埋設或貼附在梁體的溫度計取得有效梁溫（不是氣溫），在固定錨栓前依修正表確認預設刻度，拍照記錄刻度與溫度讀值；若安裝溫度超出表列範圍，暫停並請設計者與製造商重算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain the effective girder temperature from embedded or surface-mounted thermometers, not air temperature, confirm the preset scale against the correction table before anchors are fixed, and photograph the scale with the temperature reading; if the installation temperature is outside the table, stop and ask the designer and manufacturer to recalculate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預設修正表與方向箭頭要印在支承本體與施工圖上，錨栓固定前設為監造查驗點，由施工、監造與製造商代表三方確認刻度、梁溫與方向後才可灌漿。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Print the preset correction table and direction arrow on the bearing and the drawings, and make anchor fixing a hold point: the contractor, inspector and manufacturer's representative jointly confirm scale, girder temperature and direction before grouting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：預設方向弄反或忽略潛變乾縮時，滑板在數年內就滑到一側極限，上座板撞上止擋，橋梁剩下的熱位移只能靠擠壓墩頂或伸縮縫吸收，導致止擋剪斷或墩身開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A reversed preset, or one that ignores creep and shrinkage, lets the plate run to one end within a few years; the upper plate hits its stop and the remaining thermal movement is forced into the pier top or the expansion joint, shearing the stop or cracking the pier. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以埋設或貼附在梁體的溫度計取得有效梁溫（不是氣溫），在固定錨栓前依修正表確認預設刻度，拍照記錄刻度與溫度讀值；若安裝溫度超出表列範圍，暫停並請設計者與製造商重算。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain the effective girder temperature from embedded or surface-mounted thermometers, not air temperature, confirm the preset scale against the correction table before anchors are fixed, and photograph the scale with the temperature reading; if the installation temperature is outside the table, stop and ask the designer and manufacturer to recalculate.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

steps.title: 預設偏移與溫度修正：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預設偏移量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Preset offset” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 預設方向弄反或忽略潛變乾縮時，滑板在數年內就滑到一側極限，上座板撞上止擋，橋梁剩下的熱位移只能靠擠壓墩頂或伸縮縫吸收，導致止擋剪斷或墩身開裂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A reversed preset, or one that ignores creep and shrinkage, lets the plate run to one end within a few years; the upper plate hits its stop and the remaining thermal movement is forced into the pier top or the expansion joint, shearing the stop or cracking the pier. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 墊層灌漿、錨栓與荷重轉移：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「墊層灌漿與運輸固定件」如何影響球面支承安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bedding grout and transport fittings” governs force, deformation or durability in “Spherical bridge-bearing installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 支承先以調整螺栓或墊片定位高程與水平，錨栓或錨筋插入預留孔，再以流動性高、無收縮的砂漿填滿下座板與墩帽之間的墊層，讓豎向力均勻傳入混凝土。墊層若有空洞，下座板會像跨越空洞的板一樣受彎，滑動材料壓力不均，甚至讓球冠局部卡住；製造商一般建議墊層不宜過厚並使用流動性砂漿。運輸時用來鎖住上下座板的固定件必須在灌漿硬化、梁體落座之後切除，否則支承被鎖死成固定點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「墊層灌漿與運輸固定件」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The bearing is first set to level and elevation on regulating screws or shims, anchor dowels are placed in preformed pockets, and a flowable non-shrink mortar fills the bed between the lower plate and the pier cap so the vertical force enters the concrete evenly. Voids in the bed make the lower plate bend like a plate spanning a hole, give uneven pressure on the sliding material and can even jam the calotte; manufacturers generally advise a thin bed of flowable mortar. The fittings that lock the plates together for transport must be cut off after the grout has hardened and the girder is seated, or the bearing is locked into a fixed point. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Bedding grout and transport fittings” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「調整高程用的鋼墊片可以留著當作永久的傳力路徑。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel shims used for levelling can stay as the permanent load path." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 墊層灌漿、錨栓與荷重轉移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bedding grout, anchors and load transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墊層灌漿與運輸固定件」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bedding grout and transport fittings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：平均墊層壓力 σ = N/A。N = 20 MN、下座板 1.3 m×1.3 m = 1.69 m²，σ = 20/1.69 ≈ 11.8 MPa；若邊緣空洞使有效面積只剩 70%，σ ≈ 20/1.183 ≈ 16.9 MPa，且下座板局部受彎。墊層砂漿強度宜取平均壓力的數倍並經設計者核定。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Average bed pressure σ = N/A. With N = 20 MN on a 1.3 m×1.3 m lower plate of 1.69 m², σ = 20/1.69 ≈ 11.8 MPa; if edge voids leave only 70% effective area, σ ≈ 20/1.183 ≈ 16.9 MPa and the plate bends locally. The bedding mortar strength should be several times the average pressure, as approved by the designer. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：灌漿前確認高程、水平度與軸線位置，灌漿時由一側連續灌入、另一側溢出以排氣，留取砂漿試體；硬化後敲擊或以預留檢查孔確認無空洞，試體強度達規定值才拆除臨時支撐並切除運輸固定件，切除後拍照存證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before grouting confirm elevation, levelness and axis position; pour continuously from one side until mortar emerges on the other to expel air and take mortar specimens; after hardening confirm no voids by tapping or inspection ports, and only when specimens reach the specified strength remove temporary supports and cut the transport fittings, photographing the result.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 墊層灌漿、錨栓與荷重轉移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bedding grout, anchors and load transfer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「墊層灌漿與運輸固定件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bedding grout and transport fittings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 灌漿前確認高程、水平度與軸線位置，灌漿時由一側連續灌入、另一側溢出以排氣，留取砂漿試體；硬化後敲擊或以預留檢查孔確認無空洞，試體強度達規定值才拆除臨時支撐並切除運輸固定件，切除後拍照存證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before grouting confirm elevation, levelness and axis position; pour continuously from one side until mortar emerges on the other to expel air and take mortar specimens; after hardening confirm no voids by tapping or inspection ports, and only when specimens reach the specified strength remove temporary supports and cut the transport fittings, photographing the result. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把「墊層灌漿完成並經檢查」與「運輸固定件切除」列為兩個獨立的停留查驗點，查驗紀錄須含砂漿強度、空洞檢查與切除照片，未經簽認不得拆除臨時支撐或開放載重。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Make completed and inspected bedding grout and removal of transport fittings two separate hold points; records include mortar strength, void checks and photos of the cut fittings, and temporary supports may not be removed nor load applied until both are signed off.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：運輸固定件未切除會讓滑動支承變成固定支承，第一個季節的溫差就在墩頂累積巨大約束力；墊層空洞或以墊片永久承載則造成下座板翹曲、滑動材料偏壓與異常磨耗。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Leaving transport fittings in place turns a sliding bearing into a fixed one, and the first season's temperature change builds large restraint forces at the pier top; bed voids, or shims left as the permanent load path, warp the lower plate and cause eccentric pressure and abnormal wear on the sliding material. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 灌漿前確認高程、水平度與軸線位置，灌漿時由一側連續灌入、另一側溢出以排氣，留取砂漿試體；硬化後敲擊或以預留檢查孔確認無空洞，試體強度達規定值才拆除臨時支撐並切除運輸固定件，切除後拍照存證。
knowledge.textEn: Before grouting confirm elevation, levelness and axis position; pour continuously from one side until mortar emerges on the other to expel air and take mortar specimens; after hardening confirm no voids by tapping or inspection ports, and only when specimens reach the specified strength remove temporary supports and cut the transport fittings, photographing the result.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把「墊層灌漿完成並經檢查」與「運輸固定件切除」列為兩個獨立的停留查驗點，查驗紀錄須含砂漿強度、空洞檢查與切除照片，未經簽認不得拆除臨時支撐或開放載重。
knowledge.textEn: Make completed and inspected bedding grout and removal of transport fittings two separate hold points; records include mortar strength, void checks and photos of the cut fittings, and temporary supports may not be removed nor load applied until both are signed off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「墊層灌漿、錨栓與荷重轉移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
PTFE does not wear, so a sliding bearing is maintenance-free once installed.
Before grouting confirm elevation, levelness and axis position.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 墊層灌漿、錨栓與荷重轉移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bedding grout, anchors and load transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「墊層灌漿與運輸固定件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bedding grout and transport fittings” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 運輸固定件未切除會讓滑動支承變成固定支承，第一個季節的溫差就在墩頂累積巨大約束力；墊層空洞或以墊片永久承載則造成下座板翹曲、滑動材料偏壓與異常磨耗。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Leaving transport fittings in place turns a sliding bearing into a fixed one, and the first season's temperature change builds large restraint forces at the pier top; bed voids, or shims left as the permanent load path, warp the lower plate and cause eccentric pressure and abnormal wear on the sliding material. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：運輸時用來鎖住上下座板的固定件必須在灌漿硬化、梁體落座之後切除，否則支承被鎖死成固定點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The fittings that lock the plates together for transport must be cut off after the grout has hardened and the girder is seated, or the bearing is locked into a fixed point.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「調整高程用的鋼墊片可以留著當作永久的傳力路徑。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steel shims used for levelling can stay as the permanent load path." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Bedding grout, anchors and load transfer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「型式試驗與出廠檢驗」與「位移指標與溫度回歸」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Type testing and factory inspection" and "Movement indicator and temperature regression": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 型式試驗與出廠檢驗：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Type testing and factory inspection: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「摩擦係數型式試驗」如何影響球面支承安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Friction type test” governs force, deformation or durability in “Spherical bridge-bearing installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 支承的性能來自滑動材料、不鏽鋼面、潤滑與幾何配合的組合，因此要以型式試驗證明一個設計在規定壓力、溫度與滑移速度下的摩擦係數與耐久性，再以出廠檢驗確認每一顆量產支承的尺寸、材料與組裝與型式一致。大型支承常無法整顆試驗，會以縮尺試件做摩擦與耐久試驗、以實尺寸零件做尺寸與材料檢查，業主也可要求抽樣做荷重試驗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「摩擦係數型式試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A bearing's performance comes from the combination of sliding material, stainless surface, lubrication and geometric fit, so type tests demonstrate a design's friction coefficient and durability at specified pressure, temperature and sliding speed, and factory inspection confirms each production bearing matches the type in dimensions, materials and assembly. Very large bearings often cannot be tested whole, so friction and endurance tests use scaled specimens while full-size parts are checked for dimensions and materials, and owners may require sample load tests. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Friction type test” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：摩擦係數 μ = H/N。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Friction coefficient μ = H/N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支承只要額定荷重夠大，任何轉角與溫度下都一定合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a bearing's rated load is high enough, it passes at any rotation and temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「摩擦係數型式試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Friction type test”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 型式試驗與出廠檢驗
knowledge.text: 支承的性能來自滑動材料、不鏽鋼面、潤滑與幾何配合的組合，因此要以型式試驗證明一個設計在規定壓力、溫度與滑移速度下的摩擦係數與耐久性，再以出廠檢驗確認每一顆量產支承的尺寸、材料與組裝與型式一致。大型支承常無法整顆試驗，會以縮尺試件做摩擦與耐久試驗、以實尺寸零件做尺寸與材料檢查，業主也可要求抽樣做荷重試驗。
knowledge.textEn: A bearing's performance comes from the combination of sliding material, stainless surface, lubrication and geometric fit, so type tests demonstrate a design's friction coefficient and durability at specified pressure, temperature and sliding speed, and factory inspection confirms each production bearing matches the type in dimensions, materials and assembly. Very large bearings often cannot be tested whole, so friction and endurance tests use scaled specimens while full-size parts are checked for dimensions and materials, and owners may require sample load tests.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支承只要額定荷重夠大，任何轉角與溫度下都一定合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a bearing's rated load is high enough, it passes at any rotation and temperature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「型式試驗與出廠檢驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Type testing and factory inspection" is correct?
options: 支承只要額定荷重夠大，任何轉角與溫度下都一定合格。
支承的性能來自滑動材料、不鏽鋼面、潤滑與幾何配合的組合，因此要以型式試驗證明一個設計在規定壓力、溫度與滑移速度下的摩擦係數與耐久性，再以出廠檢驗確認每一顆量產支承的尺寸、材料與組裝與型式一致。
位移指針還在刻度範圍內，就代表支承功能正常。

A bearing's performance comes from the combination of sliding material, stainless surface, lubrication and geometric fit, so type tests demonstrate a design's friction coefficient and durability at specified pressure, temperature and sliding speed, and factory inspection confirms each production bearing matches the type in dimensions, materials and assembly.
